SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\ncontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n\n    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n\n    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n\n    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n\n    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n\n    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n\n    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n\n    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n    uint256 public totalShares;\n\n    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n\n    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n\n    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n\n    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n    error NoSharesMinted();\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error InsufficientShares();\n\n    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n        Ownable(initialOwner)\n    {\n        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n\n        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n\n        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n\n        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n\n        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n        totalShares += shares;\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n\n        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n        totalShares -= shares;\n        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n\n        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalAssetsStored;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n    /// @param shares Share amount.\n    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n  }\n25\t\n26\t    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n27\t        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n28\t        _burn(from, amount);\n29\t    }\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t/// supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n43\t        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n44\t        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, MockAToken is ERC20 {\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _burn(from, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Stand-in for the Aave V3 pool used across the test suite.\ncontract MockAavePool is IAavePool {\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    MockAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new MockAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n83\t    }\n84\t\n85\t    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n86\t        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n87\t    }\n88\t\n89\t SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAavePool public pool;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                               CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n    }\n\n    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                DEPOSIT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                WITHDRAW\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Withdrawn(alice, 997e6, shares, 3e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_PartialWithdraw() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares / 2);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), shares / 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawZeroShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.ZeroShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawExceedsBalance() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.InsufficientShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares + 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  FEES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeUpdatesValue() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(false, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.DepositFeeUpdated(INITIAL_FEE_BPS, 25);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeToZero() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerSetsDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 PAUSING\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_PauseBlocksDeposit() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_UnpauseRestoresDeposit() public {\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.unpause();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerPauses() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.pause();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  VIEWS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_TotalAssetsStartsAtZero() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceStartsAtOneUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.sharePrice(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 1e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlying() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlyingIsZeroForNonDepositor() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), 0);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":300,"startLine":1,"totalLines":300}}}

The\n///      repo's own `test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol` uses a plain fixed-supply\n///      ERC20 instead, which is why no existing test can observe interest.\ncontract AccruingAToken {\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    string public constant name = \"Aave Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"aUSDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    mapping(address account => uint256 scaled) public scaledBalanceOf;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    constructor() {\n        pool = msg.sender;\n    }\n\n    function _index() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return AccruingAavePool(pool).liquidityIndex();\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(scaledBalanceOf[account], _index(), RAY);\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(scaledTotalSupply, _index(), RAY);\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        uint256 scaled = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, _index());\n        scaledBalanceOf[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        uint256 scaled = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, _index(), Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        scaledBalanceOf[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that actually pays interest.\n/// @dev Identical to `test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol` except that the receipt\n///      token rebases, which is the whole point of supplying to Aave.\ncontract AccruingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    MockUSDT public immutable underlying;\n    AccruingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    uint256 public liquidityIndex = 1e27;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = MockUSDT(_underlying);\n        aToken = new AccruingAToken();\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        IERC20(address(underlying)).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n        IERC20(address(underlying)).transfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Accrues `bps` basis points of interest to every aToken holder,\n    ///         and backs it with real underlying, exactly as Aave does.\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external {\n        uint256 supplyBefore = aToken.totalSupply();\n        liquidityIndex = (liquidityIndex * (10_000 + bps)) / 10_000;\n        uint256 minted = aToken.totalSupply() - supplyBefore;\n        underlying.mint(address(this), minted);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":708,"cache_read_input_tokens":57086,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":708},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"be4bd682-39f9-41d3-ba99-9a4d315288d3","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:20:51.639Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEfMcambui93a1Nb2yY"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEh1Xf2jtHmYPbYQSV2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MMmSBBZEs3Ws2nSsCN5WoA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081450Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/test/harness/NonStandardUsdt.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\n/// @notice Faithful local stand-in for mainnet USDT (TetherToken) at\n///         0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7.\n/// @dev Reproduces the three ways real USDT departs from `IERC20`:\n///        1. `approve`, `transfer` and `transferFrom` return NOTHING.\n///        2. `approve` reverts when moving a non-zero allowance to another\n///           non-zero value.\n///        3. `transfer`/`transferFrom` can levy a fee (`basisPointsRate`,\n///           capped at `maximumFee`) so the recipient is credited less than\n///           the amount passed in. Both are 0 on mainnet today, but the\n///           setter is live and owner-callable.\n///      `test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol` is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20 and has none\n///      of these properties, which is why the existing suite is green.\ncontract NonStandardUsdt {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate;\n    uint256 public maximumFee;\n    address public owner;\n\n    mapping(address account => uint256) public balances;\n    mapping(address account => mapping(address spender => uint256)) public allowed;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    constructor() {\n        owner = msg.sender;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return balances[account];\n    }\n\n    function allowance(address _owner, address _spender) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return allowed[_owner][_spender];\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balances[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Mirrors TetherToken.setParams (owner-only, maxes at 20 bps / 50 USDT).\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"not owner\");\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        require(newMaxFee < 50, \"fee too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 Both are 0 on mainnet today, but the\n///           setter is live and owner-callable.\n///      `test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol` is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20 and has none\n///      of these properties, which is why the existing suite is green.\ncontract NonStandardUsdt {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate;\n    uint256 public maximumFee;\n    address public owner;\n\n    mapping(address account => uint256) public balances;\n    mapping(address account => mapping(address spender => uint256)) public allowed;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    constructor() {\n        owner = msg.sender;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return balances[account];\n    }\n\n    function allowance(address _owner, address _spender) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return allowed[_owner][_spender];\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balances[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Mirrors TetherToken.setParams (owner-only, maxes at 20 bps / 50 USDT).\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"not owner\");\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        require(newMaxFee < 50, \"fee too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 ** decimals);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no return value, exactly like TetherToken.\n    function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) external {\n        require(!((_value != 0) && (allowed[msg.sender][_spender] != 0)), \"unsafe approve\");\n        allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no return value, exactly like TetherToken.\n    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) external {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no return value, exactly like TetherToken.\n    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) external {\n        uint256 _allowance = allowed[_from][msg.sender];\n        if (_allowance < type(uint256).max) {\n            allowed[_from][msg.sender] = _allowance - _value;\n        }\n        _transfer(_from, _to, _value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) internal {\n        uint256 fee = (_value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 sendAmount = _value - fee;\n\n        balances[_from] -= _value;\n        balances[_to] += sendAmount;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balances[owner] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(_from, owner, fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(_from, _to, sendAmount);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEiT3M3hLDMVxaX4Qga","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01E4LVkPFpFKokmTbZDehd1A","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081450Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/test/audit/Accounting.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"../harness/AccruingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Asserts the properties the README and the NatSpec promise:\n///         depositors earn the Aave yield, and both fees \"stay supplied in\n///         Aave and accrue to the remaining shareholders\".\n///         Every test in here is expected to FAIL against src/ as it stands.\ncontract AccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 10_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    function _withdrawAll(address account) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(account));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    FINDING 1 - YIELD NEVER REACHES ANYONE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `totalAssets()` must track what the vault actually owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAaveBalance() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // 5% interest, as Aave would pay over time\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"totalAssets() ignores accrued Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A sole depositor in a yield vault must not end up poorer after\n    ///         the underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_SoleDepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        uint256 got = usdt.balanceOf(alice) - before;\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"alice got back after +5% APY :\", got);\n\n        assertGe(got, DEPOSIT, \"depositor lost principal despite the position earning 5%\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Once everybody has exited, nothing of value may be left behind.\n    function test_NoValueIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored            :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"value left in Aave that no share can ever claim\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                FINDING 2 - THE WITHDRAWAL FEE IS DESTROYED\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders\". Alice's exit fee must reach Bob.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        uint256 gross = net * 10_000 / (10_000 - vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS());\n        uint256 fee = gross - net;\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice withdrawal fee charged :\", fee);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim before alice exited:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim after alice exited :\", bobAfter);\n\n        assertGt(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"withdrawal fee was charged but credited to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice With no interest at all, the vault must not leak value: what\n    ///         went in must be claimable by the shares that exist.\n    function test_FeesAloneDoNotStrandValue() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n        _withdrawAll(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"withdrawal fees are unrecoverable, not redistributed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        SUPPORTING OBSERVATION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Documents the size of the leak over a year at ~5% with churn.\n    ///         Informational: this one passes, it just prints the numbers.\n    function test_Report_LeakOverOneYear() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < 12; ++i) {\n            pool.accrue(41); // ~0.41%/month ~= 5%/yr\n        }\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) + vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held by vault          :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"claimable by all shareholders:\", claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable                  :\", held - claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable, as bps of TVL   :\", (held - claimable) * 10_000 / held);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1977,"cache_read_input_tokens":59698,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1977},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"06bd8835-e543-4c84-b633-36195d5ce2dd","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:43.134Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEiRuPVoxEQaisSEccm"}

}","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"../harness/AccruingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Asserts the properties the README and the NatSpec promise:\n///         depositors earn the Aave yield, and both fees \"stay supplied in\n///         Aave and accrue to the remaining shareholders\".\n///         Every test in here is expected to FAIL against src/ as it stands.\ncontract AccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 10_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    function _withdrawAll(address account) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(account));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    FINDING 1 - YIELD NEVER REACHES ANYONE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `totalAssets()` must track what the vault actually owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAaveBalance() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // 5% interest, as Aave would pay over time\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"totalAssets() ignores accrued Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A sole depositor in a yield vault must not end up poorer after\n    ///         the underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_SoleDepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        uint256 got = usdt.balanceOf(alice) - before;\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"alice got back after +5% APY :\", got);\n\n        assertGe(got, DEPOSIT, \"depositor lost principal despite the position earning 5%\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Once everybody has exited, nothing of value may be left behind.\n    function test_NoValueIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored            :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"value left in Aave that no share can ever claim\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                FINDING 2 - THE WITHDRAWAL FEE IS DESTROYED\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders\". Alice's exit fee must reach Bob.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        uint256 gross = net * 10_000 / (10_000 - vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS());\n        uint256 fee = gross - net;\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice withdrawal fee charged :\", fee);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim before alice exited:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim after alice exited :\", bobAfter);\n\n        assertGt(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"withdrawal fee was charged but credited to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice With no interest at all, the vault must not leak value: what\n    ///         went in must be claimable by the shares that exist.\n    function test_FeesAloneDoNotStrandValue() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n        _withdrawAll(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"withdrawal fees are unrecoverable, not redistributed\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        SUPPORTING OBSERVATION\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Documents the size of the leak over a year at ~5% with churn.\n    ///         Informational: this one passes, it just prints the numbers.\n    function test_Report_LeakOverOneYear() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < 12; ++i) {\n            pool.accrue(41); // ~0.41%/month ~= 5%/yr\n        }\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 claimable = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice) + vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held by vault          :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"claimable by all shareholders:\", claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable                  :\", held - claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable, as bps of TVL   :\", (held - claimable) * 10_000 / held);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":45,"oldLines":8,"newStart":45,"newLines":9,"lines":["     }"," ","     function _withdrawAll(address position earning 5%\");","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"../harness/AccruingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Asserts the properties the README and the NatSpec promise:\n///         depositors earn the Aave yield, and both fees \"stay supplied in\n///         Aave and accrue to the remaining shareholders\".\n///         Every test in here is expected to FAIL against src/ as it stands.\ncontract AccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 10_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    function _withdrawAll(address account) internal returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(account);\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    FINDING 1 - YIELD NEVER REACHES ANYONE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `totalAssets()` must track what the vault actually owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAaveBalance() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // 5% interest, as Aave would pay over time\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"totalAssets() ignores accrued Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A sole depositor in a yield vault must not end up poorer after\n    ///         the underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_SoleDepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        uint256 got = usdt.balanceOf(alice) - before;\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"alice got back after +5% APY :\", got);\n\n        assertGe(got, DEPOSIT, \"depositor lost principal despite the position earning 5%\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Once everybody has exited, nothing of value may be left behind.\n    function test_NoValueIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored            :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"value left in Aave that no share can ever claim\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                FINDING 2 - THE WITHDRAWAL FEE IS DESTROYED\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders\". Alice's exit fee must reach Bob.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n        uint256 gross = net * 10_000 / (10_000 - vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS());\n        uint256 fee = gross - net;\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice withdrawal fee charged :\", fee);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim before alice exited:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim after alice exited :\", bobAfter);\n\n        assertGt(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"withdrawal fee was charged but credited to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice With no interest at all, the vault must not leak value: what\n    ///         went in must be claimable by properties the README and the NatSpec promise:\n///         depositors earn the Aave yield, and both fees \"stay supplied in\n///         Aave and accrue to the remaining shareholders\".\n///         Every test in here is expected to FAIL against src/ as it stands.\ncontract AccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool internal pool;\n    AccruingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 10_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    function _withdrawAll(address account) internal returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(account);\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    FINDING 1 - YIELD NEVER REACHES ANYONE\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `totalAssets()` must track what the vault actually owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAaveBalance() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        pool.accrue(500); // 5% interest, as Aave would pay over time\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"totalAssets() ignores accrued Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A sole depositor in a yield vault must not end up poorer after\n    ///         the underlying position earned 5%.\n    function test_SoleDepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        uint256 got = _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"alice got back after +5% APY :\", got);\n        console2.log(\"wallet before                :\", before);\n        console2.log(\"wallet after                 :\", usdt.balanceOf(alice));\n\n        assertGe(usdt.balanceOf(alice), before, \"depositor is poorer than before, despite the position earning 5%\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Once everybody has exited, nothing of value may be left behind.\n    function test_NoValueIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        pool.accrue(500);\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored            :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"value left in Aave that no share can ever claim\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                FINDING 2 - THE WITHDRAWAL FEE IS DESTROYED\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders\". Alice's exit fee must reach Bob.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n        uint256 gross = net * 10_000 / (10_000 - vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS());\n        uint256 fee = gross - net;\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice withdrawal fee charged :\", fee);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim before alice exited:\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim after alice exited :\", bobAfter);\n\n        assertGt(bobAfter, bobBefore, \"withdrawal fee was charged but credited to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice With no interest at all, the vault must not leak value: what\n    ///         went in must be claimable by the shares that exist.\n    function test_FeesAloneDoNotStrandValue() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _withdrawAll(alice);\n        _withdrawAll(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares                  :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded in vault      :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"precondition: all shares burned\");\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"withdrawal fees are unrecoverable, not redistributed\");\n    }\n\n {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < 12; ++i) {\n            pool.accrue(41); // ~0.41%/month ~= 5%/yr\n        }\n\n        uint256 held);\n        console2.log(\"claimable by all shareholders:\", claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable                  :\", held - claimable);\n        console2.log(\"unclaimable, as bps of {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEqRdxKT46F5EXn12u7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Kik4XfbGUMeoZQ7hq1gWXf","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081450Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/test/audit/OwnerPowers.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice What the owner key can do to depositors. Uses the repo's own mocks,\n///         so nothing here depends on my harness.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The deposit fee must be bounded. 100% is not a fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsCapped() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        console2.log(\"depositFeeBps now            :\", vault.depositFeeBps());\n\n        assertLe(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_000, \"deposit fee can exceed 100%\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor must receive shares worth roughly what they paid,\n    ///         whatever the owner does in the same block.\n    /// @dev Sandwich: the owner holds shares, sees alice's 10,000 USDT deposit\n    ///      in the mempool, front-runs it with setDepositFee(9999) and\n    ///      back-runs it by restoring the fee. The fee is not swept to the\n    ///      owner -- it is credited to existing shareholders, which here is\n    ///      the owner. No timelock, no cap, effective immediately.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateAPendingDeposit() public {\n        // Owner takes a small position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        // --- front-run ---\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        // --- victim's transaction, unchanged ---\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        // --- back-run: put the fee back so the next block looks normal ---\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", uint256(10_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"alice can now claim          :\", aliceClaim);\n        console2.log(\"owner deposited              :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"owner can now claim          :\", ownerClaim);\n        console2.log(\"value moved alice -> owner   :\", ownerClaim - 1_000e6);\n\n        assertGe(aliceClaim, 9_900e6, \"owner front-ran the deposit and took it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pausing may stop new deposits, but it must never trap money\n    ///         that is already in the vault.\n    function test_PauseCannotTrapExistingDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares                 :\", shares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim (locked)         :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares); // expected: succeeds. actual: EnforcedPause()\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Informational: a paused vault whose owner has renounced is\n    ///         permanently frozen -- unpause() is onlyOwner and owner is 0.\n    ///         This one passes; it documents that the state is reachable.\n    function test_Report_PausedPlusRenouncedIsTerminal() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused());\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console2.log(\"owner                        :\", vault.owner());\n        console2.log(\"paused                       :\", vault.paused());\n        console2.log(\"USDT locked forever          :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1441,"cache_read_input_tokens":70834,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1441},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"d8dd5062-f90d-49a3-960b-b78693a925a7","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:19.191Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEqQJqhsGNrt2y7XkF7"}

The fee is not swept to the\n    ///      owner -- it is credited to existing shareholders, which here is\n    ///      the owner. No timelock, no cap, effective immediately.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateAPendingDeposit() public {\n        // Owner takes a small position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        // --- front-run ---\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        // --- victim's transaction, unchanged ---\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        // --- back-run: put the fee back so the next block looks normal ---\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited              :\", uint256(10_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"alice can now claim          :\", aliceClaim);\n        console2.log(\"owner deposited              :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"owner can now claim          :\", ownerClaim);\n        console2.log(\"value moved alice -> owner   :\", ownerClaim - 1_000e6);\n\n        assertGe(aliceClaim, 9_900e6, \"owner front-ran the deposit and took it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pausing may stop new deposits, but it must never trap money\n    ///         that is already in the vault.\n    function test_PauseCannotTrapExistingDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares                 :\", shares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim (locked)         :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares); // expected: succeeds. actual: EnforcedPause()\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Informational: a paused vault whose owner has renounced is\n    ///         permanently frozen -- unpause() is onlyOwner and owner is 0.\n    ///         This one passes; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEtHUf4bbXARzbrpPYL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":950,"cache_read_input_tokens":75272,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":950},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"993c4f85-42a9-409c-b8cf-65a8552be43b","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:43.646Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEtG26kxpjKSehCLgYB"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEtHUf4bbXARzbrpPYL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016VS1Edju4SngZGLa3Rajdv","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081450Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/test/harness/SafeAavePool.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that moves tokens the way the real pool does.\n/// @dev Real Aave V3 pulls the underlying with GPv2SafeERC20, so it works with\n///      return-value-less tokens like USDT. `test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol` calls\n///      `IERC20.transferFrom` directly, which does not. This harness uses\n///      SafeERC20 so that a failure in a test is attributable to the vault, not\n///      to the pool stand-in.\ncontract SafeAavePool is IAavePool {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    mapping(address account => uint256) public aBalance;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aBalance[onBehalfOf] += amount;\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        require(amount != 0, \"26\"); // real Aave reverts with error 26 (INVALID_AMOUNT)\n        aBalance[msg.sender] -= amount;\n        underlying.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":950,"cache_read_input_tokens":75272,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":950},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"1ec3a389-f1e2-4dd5-9de7-ac8caf7df476","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:23:52.019Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEtG26kxpjKSehCLgYB"}

This harness uses\n///      SafeERC20 so that a failure in a test is attributable to the vault, not\n///      to the pool stand-in.\ncontract SafeAavePool is IAavePool {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    mapping(address account => uint256) public aBalance;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aBalance[onBehalfOf] += amount;\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        require(amount != 0, \"26\"); // real Aave reverts with error 26 (INVALID_AMOUNT)\n        aBalance[msg.sender] -= amount;\n        underlying.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {NonStandardUsdt} from \"../harness/NonStandardUsdt.sol\";\nimport {SafeAavePool} from \"../harness/SafeAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The vault is named after USDT and ships against mainnet USDT, but\n///         the whole test suite runs against a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20.\n///         These tests swap in a token with mainnet USDT's actual semantics.\n///         Offline mirror of test/fork/MainnetUsdt.t.sol.\ncontract RealUsdtCompatTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    NonStandardUsdt internal usdt;\n    SafeAavePool internal pool;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new NonStandardUsdt();\n        pool = new SafeAavePool(address(usdt));\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(0xa), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The headline: can anyone deposit at all on mainnet?\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstMainnetUsdtSemantics() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n\n        console2.log(\"shares minted                :\", shares);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pinpoints the offending line: UsdtYieldVault.sol:94 calls\n    ///         `usdt.approve(...)` through IERC20, which ABI-decodes a bool\n    ///         from the return data. Mainnet USDT returns 0 bytes.\n    function test_UsdtApproveReturnsABool() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(usdt).call(abi.encodeCall(NonStandardUsdt.approve, (address(pool), 1)));\n\n        console2.log(\"call succeeded               :\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"return data length (bytes)   :\", ret.length);\n\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"USDT.approve returns nothing; IERC20.approve requires 32 bytes of bool\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Second, independent USDT incompatibility: an existing non-zero\n    ///         allowance cannot be overwritten with another non-zero value.\n    ///         `deposit()` re-approves on every call without zeroing first, so\n    ///         any allowance left behind by a partially-consumed approval\n    ///         bricks the vault permanently.\n    function test_ReApprovingANonZeroAllowanceSucceeds() public {\n        vm.startPrank(address(vault));\n        usdt.approve(address(pool), 5_000e6);\n        usdt.approve(address(pool), 10_000e6); // expected: fine. actual: reverts\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Latent risk: USDT's transfer fee switch is live and owner-callable.\n    ///         With it on, the vault is credited less USDT than it accounts for.\n    ///         This test passes -- it demonstrates the mechanism, and that the\n    ///         vault has no defence against it.\n    function test_Report_UsdtTransferFeeSwitchShortchangesTheVault() public {\n        usdt.setParams(10, 30); // 10 bps, capped at 30 USDT -- within Tether's own limits\n\n        uint256 sent = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 vaultBefore = usdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.transfer(address(vault), sent);\n\n        uint256 received = usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vaultBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"amount passed to transfer    :\", sent);\n        console2.log(\"amount actually received     :\", received);\n        console2.log(\"shortfall                    :\", sent - received);\n\n        assertLt(received, sent);\n        // deposit() would credit shares for `sent`, then try to supply `sent`\n        // to Aave while holding only `received`.\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2034,"cache_read_input_tokens":76222,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2034},"output_tokens":62,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"f85bb541-bc02-49bd-b699-73d5dc536342","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:24:11.335Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEvFJzM11Zdhg3ex871"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSExWFiJ6GbtbKKrFVkz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XzjWfauRaVxbHCU4HGNcf3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081450Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/test/audit/Rounding.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\nimport {SafeAavePool} from \"../harness/SafeAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract RoundingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burning shares must always return something, or revert. It must\n    ///         never silently consume the caller's shares for zero USDT.\n    function test_WithdrawNeverBurnsSharesForNothing() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 dust = 9e11; // convertToAssets(9e11) rounds to 0\n        uint256 sharesBefore = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 usdtBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(dust);\n\n        console2.log(\"shares burned                :\", sharesBefore - vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        console2.log(\"USDT received                :\", usdt.balanceOf(alice) - usdtBefore);\n        console2.log(\"return value                 :\", net);\n\n        assertGt(net, 0, \"shares burned for zero USDT\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Same call against a pool that rejects zero-amount withdrawals,\n    ///         the way the real Aave V3 pool does (error 26, INVALID_AMOUNT).\n    ///         On mainnet this is a hard revert, not a silent loss.\n    function test_DustWithdrawAgainstRealAaveSemantics() public {\n        SafeAavePool safePool = new SafeAavePool(address(usdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(safePool), 10, owner);\n\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n        v.deposit(1_000e6);\n        v.withdraw(9e11); // expected: returns dust. actual: reverts inside Aave\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Any non-zero share amount should be worth something, or the\n    ///         call should revert. Finds the boundary automatically.\n    function testFuzz_WithdrawIsNeverAFreeBurn(uint256 shares) public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        shares = bound(shares, 1, vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 net = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertGt(net, 0, \"shares burned for zero USDT\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2080,"cache_read_input_tokens":80914,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2080},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8cb921a4-3a7f-4a99-af8e-8c57c6d1b3d9","uuid":"4288cbcf-a47c-49f4-a393-94ed5f5461eb","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:24:52.150Z","request_id":"req_011CdSExUjC8QyKa27EpkBet"}
